name: github
description: GitHub operations via the authenticated gh CLI: auth, api, pr list/view/create/merge/close, issue list/view/create/close, repo view, search, and a raw 'run --' escape hatch. Reference connector for external services.
use_when: interacting with GitHub — PRs, issues, repos, code search, API calls

args.name: pr|issue <op>
args.description: list (--state --limit --repo), view <num>, create --title [--body] [--base --head for pr], close <num>, merge <num> (pr).

args.name: run -- <gh args>
args.description: Escape hatch for any gh subcommand.

env.GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN: Used by gh if set; keyring auth otherwise.
